description: Use when you need a dated number on the AI industry rather than a story: New Runtime's tracker lines (open roles at AI labs, scheduled model shutdowns per API platform, more over time), each point read from a primary source and graded A-D for evidence. Without line: the lines and their series. With line: per series the latest value, its change over 7 and 30 days and the dated points (one metric, from since), plus open forecasts the line can resolve. CC BY 4.0. Free, no auth. Example: {"line": "ai-lab-hiring", "metric": "anthropic", "since": "2026-11-01"}.

line.description: Line slug; call without arguments to list them.

metric.description: One series of the line (a company key, an API platform).

since.description: Only points on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: get_tracker

count.description: Without line: how many lines exist.

forecasts.description: With line: open forecasts of the ledger the line can resolve.

grades.description: Evidence grades A-D and what each means.

license.description: CC BY 4.0 with the attribution to give.

lines.description: Without line: every line with its metrics and routes.

method.description: With line: how points are read.

series.description: With line: per series the latest value, 7- and 30-day change, stale flag and dated points.

points_truncated.description: true when older points were cut.

stale.description: true when no reading is newer than the line allows.

since.description: With line: the since filter, or null.

so_what_for_engineer.description: With line: why the line matters to an engineer.

status.description: live, or collecting before the first export.

unit.description: With line: what one value counts.

title: Read a New Runtime tracker line
